items.title: Timberwolves agree to deal with former Gonzaga star Drew Timme
items.author: HoopsHype
items.body_excerpt: Timberwolves agree to deal with former Gonzaga star Drew Timme HoopsHype

items.title: The Minnesota Timberwolves and Drew Timme have agreed to a deal, league sources told HoopsHype. Timme will compete for a spot in training camp. The former Gonzaga star has averaged 5.6 points and 2.7 rebounds in two NBA seasons with the Brooklyn Nets and Los Angeles Lakers.
items.author: Michael Scotto
